questions.question: During a famine, God told Isaac that through his offspring all nations of the earth would be blessed. True or false?
While living in Gerar, why did Isaac tell the men there that his wife Rebekah was his sister?

answers.text: He was afraid they would kill him for her
He hoped the king would give him land
He wanted the men there to trust him

questions.question: After the Philistines grew jealous of Isaac's wealth, what did they do to the wells Abraham's servants had dug?
King Abimelech came to Isaac and said the LORD was with him. What did Abimelech ask for?

answers.text: An oath that Isaac would not harm them
A share of all of Isaac's new wells
Isaac's servants to fight in their wars
